mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of a broader economic slowdown and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where HOUST decreases by more than 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5%, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy in a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 month-over-month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200k MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When Real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where GDPC1 < 1% QoQ and CPIAUCSL > 0.3% MoM.
